description: Retrieves a list of issues for a Sentry project, defaulting to unresolved issues unless an empty `query` string is provided or specific `hashes` are used.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's `Link` header to fetch the next/previous set of issues.
cursor.title: Cursor

hashes.description: Comma-separated group hashes to retrieve specific issues; incompatible with `query`. Max 100 hashes processed.
hashes.title: Hashes

organization_id_or_slug.description: Unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug of the Sentry organization.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

project_id_or_slug.description: Unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug of the Sentry project.
project_id_or_slug.title: Project Id Or Slug

query.description: Sentry structured search query to filter issues (e.g., "is:resolved", "error.type:TypeError"). Defaults to "is:unresolved"; `""` retrieves all issues regardless of status. IMPORTANT: Boolean operators "OR" and "AND" are NOT supported in Issue search - they will cause an error. To search multiple values for the same key, use list syntax: `key:[value1, value2]` instead of `key:value1 OR key:value2`. Use negation with `!` prefix (e.g., `!is:resolved`) to exclude results.
query.title: Query

shortIdLookup.description: If `True`, enables issue lookup by short IDs; may return issues from a different project. API default is typically `False`.
shortIdLookup.title: Short Id Lookup

statsPeriod.description: Time window for calculating issue statistics (affects the timeline stats in the response, not which issues are returned). Valid values: "" (empty string to disable stats), "24h" (last 24 hours), "14d" (last 14 days). Defaults to "24h" if not provided. Other values (e.g., "7d", "1h", "30d") are not supported.
statsPeriod.title: Stats Period
